name: softube-ts-overhead-shimmer
description: Add room/shimmer to overheads or a drum bus via the Softube Transient Shaper — the manual's overhead recipe: increase SUSTAIN on the HIGH band only (crossover 1.5 kHz) so cymbal/room tails stretch WITHOUT amplifying low-frequency tom/kick rumble. No punch. Clip off.
intended_for: an overhead stem or drum bus that wants more cymbal shimmer / room length, low end left untouched
plugin_build: Softube 'Transient Shaper.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok-authorized — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: Manual: Sustain + / HIGH / crossover 1-2 kHz — HIGH band keeps the move off the low rumble. Raising sustain also raises HF bleed/noise/cymbal wash, so don't overdo it. Expect the 8-16k band + centroid to RISE; A/B loudness-matched (it adds level/tails).
